## Checklist

- [ ] The test scripts that touch this change pass (`sh core/tests/run.sh test_name.py`)
- [ ] Changed behaviour has its page in `docs/` changed too
- [ ] A new AI tool is in `docs/tools.md` and the AI's instructions
- [ ] New screen text is wrapped in `t("text")` and `python3 scripts/i18n.py check` passes
- [ ] A new setting or environment variable is in `docs/settings.md`
- [ ] A new outside call is in `docs/privacy.md` and `docs/threat-model.md`
- [ ] Plain words, no em dashes, no three dots in text people read
- [ ] No real notes, keys, names or private details anywhere in the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line
- [ ] `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are unchanged, and I agree to "Other licenses, and contributions" in `NOTICE`
- [ ] No safety rule in `AGENTS.md` is weakened
